design: Copying old/new wording, eight name pairs, two endpoints, prefix presence crossed with initial-character lowercase. Native MLP11 contexts z00/z01/z10/z11 define case=z01-z00, prefix=z10-z00, interaction=z11-z10-z01+z00. Test local full response and components under fixed-norm number/task/random Attention5 signals, both signs. Cross-format component replacements use same name/endpoint. No fitting or gate filtering.
scope: Prefix-only retains uppercase initial word after comma. Case factor is a tokenization/orthography change, not a clean semantic variable. Same lexical inventory and known formats; new intervention decomposition. Behavior effects are not additive shares.
